title: 2026-10-23 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference (Georgia Institute of Technology, 同 SLO 下只比纯 GPU 慢 7.88%，换来 1.26x 功耗效率与 1.72x 成本效率。)、UlaCache: Unified Logical Addressing for Sparse LLM Serving (Scitix.AI, B300 上 TP 场景解码吞吐 2.51x，DP 场景 1.73x。)、To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems (University of California, TTFT 较 LRU-Pool 降 38%，跨节点 KV 传输量降 53%。)

highlights.name: HAWK
highlights.note: GPU 上 prefill、NPU 上 decode，用 RDMA 加布局感知缓冲把 KV 跨架构搬过去

highlights.name: KVLearn
highlights.note: 解耦推理里把“留不留 KV”当成要付网费的成本优化，TTFT 降 38%

highlights.name: UlaCache
highlights.note: 统一逻辑地址让稀疏注意力挑中的 KV 跨 DP/TP 都可寻址，B300 上 2.51x
